modal_instances.sentence: September 24, 2021  Introductory Remarks  Chair Jerome H. Powell  At "Fed Listens: Perspectives on the Pandemic Recovery," sponsored by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Washington, D.C. (via webcast)  Share  Watch Live  Nearly three years after we started holding Fed Listens events around the country, the program has proved to be even more valuable than we could have imagined.

I am very glad you could all join us today to offer your thoughts, and I want to thank you on behalf of the entire Federal Reserve System for both your presence today and for your continued feedback and participation.

While uncertainty often results in immobility for businesses, it can also spell opportunity, and the creativity and adaptability on display over the past 18 months have been among the few bright spots.
